zero_omission_notes.summary: Focuses on surface areas and volumes of composite 3D figures combining cylinders, cones, spheres, hemispheres, and cubes.

detailed_sections.section_number_and_title: 12.1 Surface Area of Combination of Solids
detailed_sections.full_explanation: Total Surface Area of combination = sum of exposed Curved Surface Areas. Exclude internal contacting faces.

margin_notes_and_sidebars.title: Exposed Surface Only
margin_notes_and_sidebars.content: Add only exposed CSAs of component solids.

detailed_sections.full_explanation: Total Volume = sum of individual volumes of constituent solids.

practical_lab_activity_or_methodology_ma.aim_or_objective: Calculate TSA of toy (cone on hemisphere) radius 3.5 cm, height 15.5 cm.
practical_lab_activity_or_methodology_ma.conclusion_or_principle: Internal circular interface is excluded from TSA.

competency_and_case_studies.case_scenario: Gulab jamun contains syrup ~30% of its volume. Cylinder with two hemispherical ends, length 5 cm, diameter 2.8 cm.

qa.question: Find volume of syrup in 45 gulab jamuns.
qa.answer: r = 1.4 cm, cyl height = 2.2 cm. Vol of 1 ≈ 25.05 cm^3. Total Vol = 45 * 25.05 = 1127.25 cm^3. Syrup = 30% = 338 cm^3.

common_misconceptions_and_pitfalls.common_error_or_misconception: Adding total surface areas of individual components when finding composite TSA.
common_misconceptions_and_pitfalls.correct_fact_or_method: Joined internal faces are hidden and must NOT be included in TSA.
